children.name: Develop this access
children.content:
1. To enter the OPEN API open platform, please click the [Register] button in the upper right corner to register an account on the Yuntu OPEN API platform.

2. Please select the registered role type, here select [Developer].

3. Please fill in the basic information of the account as required: user name, password and email address (the email address needs to be verified to complete the registration); after reading and agreeing to the "Development Platform Developer Registration Agreement", click the [Register] button to complete the account register.

4. Login to your account and click on [Apply for Sandbox Applications] in [console] - [Sandbox Applications]. The system will automatically create a sandbox application.

5. After obtaining the sandbox application, there will be UAT access key information, and then you can start the joint debugging test. (If you need permissions outside of the default interface, please explain the reason and submit a work order to [My Work Order] for application)

6. Click [Sandbox Test] - [Debugging], the Access Token information will be automatically generated, and you can directly select the corresponding interface in the sandbox environment to make a request.

7. After the joint debugging is successful, follow the official website registration process to log in to the user center. Select the API column to view the user's input of the corresponding open platform account sourcekey and click [Reset key]. The system will automatically generate the API key and APPID, which can be used next. To connect with the formal environment verification results.

8. After the verification of the production environment is successful, the connection is completed, and the user can use the related interface business functions of Yuntu normally.

children.name: Authorization introduction
children.content:
## 1. Why authorize?
In order to ensure the security and privacy of user data, your application needs to obtain authorization from users of Yuntu Open Platform, that is, to obtain the authorization token accessToken for accessing user account data.

## 2. Is authorization required?
All interfaces of Yuntu open platform must be authorized by the user, and the account access token after user authorization must be obtained.

## 3. Authorization prerequisite?
- Has settled in as a user of Yuntu Open Platform
- Already have an application in the "enabled" state, and obtain the application appId, appSecret information

## 4. Explanation of terms?
- appId: AppID is the identifier assigned to the application by the open platform when the application is created to identify the identity of the application
- appSecret: It is the key assigned to the application by the Yuntu open platform. The user needs to keep this key properly. This key is used to ensure the reliability of the application source and prevent it from being forged
- accessToken: Access Token is the access credential of the Yuntu user, which is generally issued after the consent of the Yuntu user. It represents the permission granted by the user to the application to access specific resources on the Yuntu Open Platform
- expiresIn: represents the expiration time of the above access credentials.

## 5. Authorization Standards
Yuntu open platform authorization system is an authorization system based on the OAuth2.0 protocol standard. It supports Yuntu open gateway interface authorization call

children.name: Oauth2.0 authentication
children.content:
OAuth provides a way for applications to access protected resources. Before an application can access a protected resource, it must first obtain authorization (access permission) from the resource owner, and then exchange the access permission for an access token (representing the scope, duration, and other properties of the permission). An application accesses a protected resource by presenting an access token to the resource server.

### Get Token
### 1. Application A (appId applied by the user) sends a request to B (gateway) on the command line
```json
Request: POST https://openapi-sbx.yunexpress.cn/openapi/oauth2/token
{
    "grantType": "client_credentials",
    "appId": "{appId}",
    "appSecret": "{appSecret}",
    "sourceKey": "{sourceKey}"
}
...
Response:
{
    "expiresIn": 7200,
    "accessToken": "ObRk6e78yUSBrxP9KLzAF4igqoWSRS7B"
}
```

In the above URL, the grantType parameter is equal to client_credentials, indicating that the credential is used, and the appId and appSecret are used to allow B to confirm the identity of A.

The return field expiresIn indicates the expiration time

### 2. After the B website passes the verification, it returns the token directly.

Token use

After website A gets the token, it can request data from the API of website B.

At this point, every request sent to the API must have a token. The specific method is to add a token field to the header information of the request, and the token is placed in this field.

```HTTP
Request: POST https://openapi-sbx.yunexpress.cn/sevice/api/xxx
Request Header: "token: ACCESS_TOKEN"
```
In the above command, ACCESS_TOKEN is the token obtained.

## 1. SDK instructions

The open platform SDK provides functions such as API request encapsulation, signature, and authorization. Developers can easily complete API calls by using the SDK.

- JAVA SDK download address: [SDK download] (https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20230626/202306261435422390030186.zip)

## 2. API call protocol

The Yuntu open platform is invoked based on the HTTP protocol, and developers need to encapsulate it as an HTTP request for invocation. Next, the API call process for self-encapsulated HTTP requests will be described in detail.

 

## 3. Call service entry

- Sandbox environment service entrance: https://openapi-sbx.yunexpress.cn
- Production environment service entrance: https://openapi.yunexpress.cn


## 4. Call parameters:
Parameters can be divided into "public parameters" and "business parameters"


## 5. Signature instructions:

When calling the API, the request parameters need to be signed, and the Yuntu Gateway server will verify whether the request parameters are correct.

For the signature algorithm, please refer to [Signature Algorithm](https://open.yunexpress.cn/openApi/doc?type=article&mid=1656132191473958913&pid=1656132802714075137&id=1656132839913357314).

children.name: Signature algorithm
children.content:
### Signature introduction
  Signature verification must have [Oauth2](https://open.yunexpress.cn/openApi/doc?type=article&mid=1656132191473958913&pid=1656132603195228161&id=1656132648883781633) authentication Token information, the client should send header information data with the following parameters :

  Field | Required | Sample | Description |
---- | ----- |---- |----
  date | Required | 1651049235123 | Get the timestamp of the current request, accurate to milliseconds
  sign | required | GNfn6oD0GtLtEYV2JVvYYtdGkblzoxE91+WqowoIwUo= | signature result

### date parameter acquisition description
Get the timestamp of the current request, accurate to milliseconds. The request is valid within 300 seconds of date clock deviation verification, and the signature verification fails after the time is exceeded.

Code example:
```JAVA
System. currentTimeMillis()
```
Example result:
```JAVA
1651049235123
```
### sign parameter acquisition instructions
The final result of the sign signature. The signature field includes: request timestamp, request method, request address, and request body.

  Field | Required | Sample | Description |
---- | ----- |---- |----
  date | Required | 1651049235123 | Get the timestamp of the current request, accurate to milliseconds
  method | required | POST | request method
  uri | required | /api/test | request address
  body | required | {} | request body. If there is a request body, it is required, if not, there is no need to add a signature

The steps to obtain the signature are as follows:

+ Step 1: Splicing signature content (content)

Orderly concatenate the request timestamp, request method, request address, and request body (the field names are in the same order), and split by &

Stitching format:
```JAVA
# has request body
body={}&date=1651049235123&method=POST&uri=/api/test

# no request body
date=1651049235123&method=POST&uri=/api/test
```

+ Step 2: Perform HmacSHA256 calculation signature on the signature content (content)

Depending on the signature key, the secret key (secret) acquisition method: login - application management - my application - application details - application secret key
```JAVA
     /**
      * Calculate the signature
      * @param content signature content
      * @param secret signature key
      * @return signature result
      */
     private static String calculationSignature(String content, String secret) throws InvalidKeyException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, UnsupportedEncodingException {
         SecretKeySpec signingKey = new SecretKeySpec(secret. getBytes(), "HmacSHA256");
         Mac mac = Mac. getInstance("HmacSHA256");
         mac.init(signingKey);
         return new String(Base64. getEncoder(). encode(mac. doFinal(content. getBytes())), "US-ASCII");
     }
```
+ Step 3: Get the signature result. The result is as follows:
```
GNfn6oD0GtLtEYV2JVvYYtdGkblzoxE91+WqowoIwUo=
```
### request example
```JAVA
Request: POST http://localhost:8000/requests \
Request Headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
    token: xxxxx
    date: 1651049235123
    sign: b4WtAP3EEPpoDR2FS9q+7qhrj93idmU+Z3Mrwdtzry0=
  Request Body:
    {"name":"zhangs"}

Response:
    HTTP/1.1 200 OK
    ...
```

import requests

import hmac

def getSign(key, message):
    # 使用 HMAC-SHA256 计算签名
    hmac_sha256 = hmac.new(key.encode('utf-8'), message.encode('utf-8'), digestmod = 'sha256')
    signature = hmac_sha256.digest()

    # 使用 base64 进行 UTF-8 编码
    encoded_signature = base64.b64encode(signature).decode('utf-8')

    return encoded_signature

#获取token
def getToken():
    # 设置请求的URL

        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }  
  
    # 发送POST请求，将data转换为json格式，并设置headers  
    response = requests.post(url, data=json.dumps(data), headers=headers)  
    
    # 检查请求是否成功

        # 如果成功，解析返回的JSON数据

children.content:
## Function Introduction
After configuring the Encrypt Key, Yuntu Open Platform will push encrypted events to the request address. Encryption push can make user data more secure, and it is recommended that users configure an Encrypt Key.
![图片.png](https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20241125/202411251505326458053030.png)

The following request address is the address where the developer server receives events. Each user can only configure one request address, and all events subscribed to by the client will be sent to that request address
![图片.png](https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20241125/202411251505034612645307.png)

After configuring the Encrypt Key, subscription operations can be performed through the API dictionary
![图片.png](https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20241125/202411251505526340974978.png)
An example of an encrypted push event is shown below:
```json
{
    "encrypt": "" 
}
```
After receiving the encrypted event, the server of the application needs to decrypt it. The example of the decrypted event is shown below. For a detailed introduction to decryption methods, please refer to "[Receive events](https://open.yunexpress.cn/openApi/doc?type=article&mid=1656132191473958913&pid=1860945060195962881&id=1860945188180955139)"
```json
{
    "schema": "2.0",
    "header": {
        "event_id": "5e3702a84e847582be8db7fb73283c02",
        "event_type": "im.message.receive_v1",
        "create_time": "1608725989000",
        "token": "rvaYgkND1GOiu5MM0E1rncYC6PLtF7JV",
        "app_id": "cli_9f5343c580712544",
        "tenant_key": "2ca1d211f64f6438"
    }
}
```
After configuring the Encrypt Key, the application server can perform signature verification based on the Encrypt Key to ensure that the application receives legitimate events pushed by the Yuntu Open Platform.

After receiving the data, the docking party returns the string "success". OpenApi receives this message and considers the push successful.

## 1、Background - The package customer shipped to our company may have some abnormalities during our logistics transportation. For some packages, we need to communicate with you and negotiate a handling plan (such as whether to return or release overweight packages). For some packages, we need to synchronize the information to you after corresponding processing (such as overseas self-pickup packages, you need to arrange for self-pickup). - In order to facilitate you to obtain the abnormal package information in a timely manner, you can subscribe to the OPENAPI interface to obtain your package abnormal information. You can also issue a processing plan to our company through our abnormal handling interface. Our company will handle it according to your needs, improve the exchange of abnormal order information, and improve the processing efficiency. ## 2、You can receive abnormal order data after subscribing to OPENAPI Prerequisite requirements: - Apply for a developer account，after applying for a developer account, our technical staff will associate the developer account you applied for with the customer code in our customer management system. ![图片.png](https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20241125/202411251408125808060493.png) - Subscribe to OPENAPI interface ![图片.png](https://file-openapi.yunexpress.cn/20250314/202503141028584171938345.png) ## 3、Receive data interface field parsing - Data dimension: Package + Exception type dimension ([waybill_number] field + [type] field in the following interface); - For packages of type [1,2], you need to provide a processing plan (such as release & return). - For packages of type [3], you need to be aware of the abnormality and make corresponding arrangements (such as arranging for self-pickup). - How do you issue processing plans?For details, see content of "5.
